name: filpgf-ecosystem
description: Shared Filecoin public goods funding context for agents: a source map from filpgf.io/llms.txt, Karma, OSO, Filecoin Data Portal and Filoscope skills.

interface.shortDescription: Find and use Filecoin PGF sources
defaultPrompt: Which sources should I use to check this FilPGF milestone?
Show onboarded data over the last week from the Filecoin Data Portal

oso.description: Open Source Observer (Artio) metrics, code activity and SQL over OSO datasets

sources.name: filpgf.io and app.filpgf.io
sources.covers: Program pages, rounds, reports, financials; entry point for agents is llms.txt

sources.name: Karma GAP API
sources.covers: Programs, funding applications, grants, milestones, payouts, Kernel functions, commitments and readings (community `filecoin`)
sources.authority: Wins for amounts, milestone status and payments
sources.report: info@karmahq.xyz (see https://www.karmahq.org/mcp/connect); no public API issue tracker verified

sources.name: Karma MCP server
sources.covers: Karma API operations, program financials, docs search
sources.access: Streamable HTTP MCP; not bundled in this toolkit
sources.auth: Every tool call needs OAuth 2.1 or a scoped x-api-key from Karma settings
sources.authority: Same data as the GAP API

sources.name: Open Source Observer (Artio)
sources.covers: Project metrics and code activity; Kernel projects on Karma carry `osoProjectSlug`
sources.access: MCP server `oso`, opt-in at build time (`--enable-mcp oso`); the newer endpoint https://mcp.artio.so/mcp is documented upstream
sources.auth: Bearer API key in OSO_TOKEN (create one at https://www.artio.so/login, org Settings / API Keys) or client-managed OAuth where the host is allowed
sources.report: Platform: https://github.com/opensource-observer/oso/issues/new; Filecoin metrics and guides: https://github.com/opensource-observer/insights/issues/new; project identities: https://github.com/opensource-observer/oss-directory/issues/new

sources.name: Filecoin Data Portal
sources.covers: Daily Parquet and DuckDB tables for network, storage provider, PDP, Filecoin Pay and market data
sources.authority: Derived chain and market datasets; check each dataset page for coverage and method

sources.name: Filoscope
sources.covers: Searchable index of Filecoin docs, FIPs, specs, code, ecosystem projects and datasets
sources.access: Local QMD index pulled through the `filoscope` npm package
sources.authority: Pointers to primary documents; cite the underlying document

sources.name: Project git repositories
sources.covers: Code and release history of each funded project
